description: We're a team from Toronto who believe NASA's view of our planet should belong to everyone, not just people who can see a screen. We built Earth Jukebox over one weekend, rewriting it again and again until it felt right: we tuned every sound against real NASA frames, rebuilt the design from scratch when it didn't feel honest, and tested the page with a screen reader ourselves to hear what a blind visitor would hear. We care about one thing: that anyone, anywhere, can hear the planet change.
